newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best upgrades NAC Re to "superior".
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best upgrades NAC Re to "superior".

text.p: A.M. Best said on Monday it raised its rating on the NAC Re Corp to "superior" from "excellent."

The rating agency said the upgrade reflects NAC Re's strong operating earnings, conservative loss reserves, superior capitalization and its leadership position within the domestic reinsurance segment.

Best also praised NAC Re for strengthening its senior management team. Best said the company's strengths include diverse product offerings, specialty market expertise and longstanding core-client relationships.
Best also upgraded NAC Re's subsidiary NAC Re International Ltd to superior from excellent.
